implementation.adapter_policy: Use the maintained NCDM architecture through a local split-safe runner; do not use the toolkit random interaction split helper.

data_protocol.held_out_student_policy: Neutral zero-history embedding: validation and test student embeddings are fixed to zero before validation/test prediction and are never calibrated from held-out responses.
data_protocol.test_evaluation_policy: One final test evaluation only after the validation-selected epoch is frozen; a local ledger blocks an accidental second evaluation.
